versions.changelog: Remove credit card endpoint, add user consent requirement, lead with non-PII endpoints
Clarify privacy: all validation is syntax-only, no data stored or forwarded

Initial release of data-validate skill:

- Validate emails (RFC 5322), URLs, E.164 phone numbers, and credit card numbers (Luhn check)
- JSON Schema (draft-07) validation support
- Simple API endpoints for each type of validation
- Free tier: 10 queries/day, no authentication needed
- Privacy-friendly: no personal data collected; IP hashing for rate limits only
